title: Accept worktree owner records written by other Susi tools
goal: Core accepts a worktree owner record written by another Susi tool (fewer fields) instead of refusing the commit as a corrupt record, so which Susi binary answers a git hook no longer decides whether a commit is allowed.

reuse.searched: crates/susi-core/src/worktree_isolation.rs (WorktreeOwner, resolve identity, process_is_alive) and the two Susi Commercial Apps writers of the same file.
reuse.reason: Serde defaults on the fields core does not need to decide ownership; process_is_alive already treats an empty host as this host. No new code path.

integration.workflow: susi harness run (mission core-owner-record), native local workflow integrate

results.worker: governed subscription worker, one attempt, landed on the first pass
results.also_proves: T-LOCALHARNESSZ0INTEGRATEZ0MAIN-1: main had passed the local integration head and integrate built on the fetched main with no operator step
results.found_by: a commit in a core worktree was refused with: corrupt worktree owner ... missing field role
